title: The Truth About 'Sugar-Free' Holiday Candy Labels: What FDA Compliance Doesn’t Tell You About Sugar Alcohols and GI Distress in Seniors
description: Analyzes how erythritol, maltitol, and xylitol impact gastric motility, osmotic diarrhea risk, and postprandial glucose variability in adults over 70 with age-related gut slowdown.

title: Holiday Travel With Diabetes After 75: 5 Critical Prep Steps You’re Missing (Especially for Air Travel & Long Car Rides)
description: Covers temperature-sensitive insulin storage, time-zone–adjusted dosing, emergency carb access protocols, and TSA-compliant documentation for older adults with reduced mobility or mild cognitive changes.

title: 12 Science-Backed Ways to Counteract Post-Holiday Weight Gain in Adults With Long-Standing Type 2 Diabetes (5+ Years)
description: Highlights strategies proven to preserve lean mass and metabolic flexibility—not just caloric restriction—including protein pacing, post-meal movement windows, and vagal tone support.
